page: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system allocates 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core using the x86_64 architecture. Cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and cryptographic instruction sets, including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AES, and SHA-NI, while excluding hardware GPU accelerators.

The instance delivers 64.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-heavy computing requirements. Ephemeral storage is provided directly by a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD local disk, alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The server does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark measurements indicate top-tier single-core CPU throughput, reaching 3,612.88 in stress-ng single-core tests, 40.23 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression, and 18.26 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Multi-core performance aligns with the middle 50% tier, achieving 14,665.45 in multi-core stress-ng and 18,241.61 in PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth reaches 862.64 GB/sec for small cached blocks, while uncached 256 MB reads and writes record 48.39 GB/sec and 33.62 GB/sec respectively. Synthetic operational metrics record 14.2 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 15.6 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Microsoft Azure E8ads_v7 offers strong cost efficiency for footprints requiring high memory-per-core density and rapid local NVMe temporary storage without paying for unneeded accelerator hardware. Primary workloads include in-memory databases like Redis, relational database systems, ETL processing pipelines, caching layers, and enterprise memory-intensive applications.
description: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores, paired with 64.0 GB of RAM for an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation. The hardware platform includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptographic extensions, with no attached GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate top-decile performance in single-core compute and compression workloads alongside balanced mid-tier multi-core and memory throughput, including 14.2 million Redis SET operations per second. With high RAM capacity and fast local scratch storage, the E8ads_v7 is well suited for memory-bound relational databases, in-memory caches, data transformation jobs, and general business enterprise services.
